text:
Anya: Quick heads-up from overnight canary of quant-rerank v2. Overall metrics ok but a focused hit on the support slice. Dumping the short summary below.

Kai: Paste the deltas pls.

Anya: Holdout ~12.3k queries. Control=prod-rerank-v1, Candidate=quant-rerank-v2.

Anya: ```
Control vs Candidate (holdout 12.3k)
RR@1       | 0.842 -> 0.835  delta -0.007 (-0.83%)
MRR        | 0.712 -> 0.708  delta -0.004 (-0.56%)
Fidelity   | 0.940 -> 0.926  delta -0.014 (-1.49%)
Top-CTR    | 0.121 -> 0.124  delta +0.003 (+2.48%)
Support-slice RR@1 | 0.812 -> 0.789  delta -0.023 (-2.83%)
```

Sam: That support delta is significant. Any example pairs?

Anya: Pasted three failing examples from the support-slice: 
1) control: "Please reset your password by following the link."\ncandidate: "Try resetting pass via link." -> candidate demotes the correct doc by one rank
2) control: "I can't access my invoices."\ncandidate: "Invoices page blank for some users." -> candidate promotes unrelated doc, worse relevance
3) control: "How do I update billing method?"\ncandidate: "You can change billing in settings." -> fine

Jess: Looks like short queries with entities (password, invoices) are getting nudged. Quantization noise on embeddings?

Mike: eval-bot posted automated check: 

eval-bot: ALERT: slice_support: RR@1 delta -2.83% exceeds warning (-1.0%). Fidelity delta -1.49% exceeds soft alarm (-1.0%). Global RR@1 delta < -1.0% so no global rollback.

Kai: Per rollout rules: if any slice RR@1 delta <= -2.0% -> immediate rollback. If any slice in (-2.0%, -1.0%] -> pause + targeted A/B.

Sam: This is <= -2.0% so qualifies for rollback. Did deploy-bot act?

deploy-bot: Promotion paused by policy: slice_violation detected for 'support'. Candidate not promoted.

Anya: I kicked off a synthetic replay (50k) amplifying fp16-style perturbations to see sensitivity. ETA ~45m. job-id=qr-replay-1768991234.

Jess: Suggestion: add per-slice sensitivity weight to promotion calculator (support has higher business impact), and tag quant experiments to run entity-specific calibration.

Mike: Proposal for updated auto-fallback thresholds:
- immediate rollback if any critical slice RR@1 delta <= -2.5% OR fidelity delta <= -1.5%
- pause & quarantine + targeted A/B if any slice RR@1 delta in (-2.5%, -1.0%]
- require 2 consecutive holdout runs showing improvement before auto-promote

Kai: +1. Also add short-circuit: if top-K concordance drop >3% on any support-intent sub-slice -> rollback.

Sam: Action items:
- Anya: finish 50k replay and upload fail/pass set to s3://redwood-lab/quant-rerank/v2/failset
- Jess: open PR to weight support slice in rollout calculator
- Mike: update rollout policy PR and add unit tests for short query behaviour
- Kai: if replay confirms, choose between calibrating quant params or reverting to hybrid quant profile

Anya: Replay finished: 50k shows same direction, support-slice RR@1 delta -2.6%. Uploaded replay CSV to s3://redwood-lab/quant-rerank/v2/replay-1768991234.csv

Mike: With replay confirmed, I'll file rollback PR and mark v2 as "quarantine" in the model catalog.

deploy-bot: Model status updated: quant-rerank-v2 -> quarantine. Promotions blocked until manual clearance.

Kai: Let's reconvene after Jess's rollout-calculator PR lands tomorrow.

Anya: Thanks all, will follow up with a few targeted eval plots and calibration runs.

eval-bot: tagging metric-watch-id mw-2026-09-04-22 for audit.

Sam: Keeping staged promotions blocked until follow-ups are complete. :thumbsup:
